glosses: line (path through two or more points)
stroke (line or mark made on a surface by an implement for drawing, writing, etc.)

examples.text: Notei um traço de ansiedade na voz dela.
examples.en: I noted a trace of eagerness in her voice.

examples.text: O eminente psicólogo tem traços fisionômicos parecidos com os de meu tio.
examples.en: The prominent psychologist resembles my uncle in appearance.
